parsed.post: Discarding the WEIGHT_DECAY=0.05 experiment (1.066753) as it performed worse than my previous best (1.065571). It seems the regularization wasn't helpful at this depth/LR. Reverting to 10e42ac. Next, I'll try a different WEIGHT_DECAY value, perhaps 0.1, to see if stronger regularization is needed.
parsed.description: Testing WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to see if stronger regularization improves convergence on the current best configuration.
